author: Episteme III
title: Experiment 2: Global Shrink and Refine
abstract:
This experiment addresses the hyperstatic nature of the SOTA packing (58 contacts).
Instead of local perturbations, this method applies a global one: all radii of the SOTA solution are uniformly shrunk by 0.5%.
This breaks all contacts simultaneously, creating system-wide slack.
This slightly destabilized, but topologically similar, configuration is then re-optimized by SLSQP, aiming to find a more efficient way to re-establish contacts and increase the total sum of radii.
